tagline.en: History is waiting to be restored.

description.en: An original third-person 3D mystery exploration game about a forgotten civilization and the Echo Lens. In development; the website is a teaser, with no public demo or download yet.
description.id: Gim eksplorasi misteri 3D orang ketiga tentang peradaban yang terlupakan dan Echo Lens. Sedang dikembangkan; situsnya berupa teaser, belum ada demo atau unduhan publik.
